title: DDE Geoscience Discovery metadata schema
description: The general DDE profile: ddeCore with no restriction on the resource type. Marked by any term from the DDE ResourceTypeCode codelist in schema:additionalType on the described resource. Independent of the resource-type profiles, so a record that also fits one of them declares both. The resource is the node with a catalog record (schema:subjectOf), so the members of a collection, which carry resource types of their own, do not count. Requires what the schema composes unconditionally. Not in an exclusiveGroup: a record with two resource types declares every profile it fits. DRAFT, generated from schema.yaml; not reviewed.
